supersedes.reason: The same-session pilot established routes and state references; the final revision additionally promotes all 19 semantic controls to real Phone/Tablet component variants and attached instances.

deltas.oldValue: Page/About had Phone and Tablet masters whose internal route content contained no attached canonical instances.
deltas.newValue: Six canonical variants cover About, Feedback, and Version at Phone 390×844 and Tablet 760×960. All device edges use radius 34; Landscape aliases Tablet; Compact/Fold is absent.

deltas.oldValue: Nineteen controls were raw imported frames with no component inheritance path.
deltas.newValue: Nineteen real component sets each expose Viewport=Phone and Viewport=Tablet. All 38 route occurrences are attached instances; the 38 source frames remain preserved hidden for recovery.

deltas.oldValue: External and update actions had no explicit About-owned interaction-state reference.
deltas.newValue: ExternalAction and UpdateAction each define Default, Pressed, Focus, Disabled, Loading, and Error. FeedbackEntryDialog defines Confirm, Loading, Success, and Failed without inventing a separate feedback form route.

deltas.oldValue: Phone 942:22 and Tablet 942:24 preserved the legacy appearance but bypassed the canonical About route graph.
deltas.newValue: Phone and Tablet masters inherit attached route instances from 2350:4824 and 2350:4825. Original raw page sources remain hidden; no detached instance was introduced.

deltas.oldValue: Four existing About occurrences pointed at Page/About masters.
deltas.newValue: All four remain attached to 942:22 or 942:24 and inherit the canonical repair; reactions remain unchanged.

deltas.oldValue: Potential recurrence risk from raw controls, non-canonical state references, and unverified device wrappers.
deltas.newValue: Exact existing icons and typography are preserved, trailing values/actions remain right aligned, active route DROP_SHADOW=0, detached=0, Compact/Fold=0, and all four edge radii equal 34.
